text:
Priya Rao: FYI — offer for L6 SWE candidate (Santiago Perez) needs a cross-region comp-band exception. Candidate is relocating US->UK. Manager ok with role but compensation parity is off. Candidate asking for start 2024-11-15 due to delayed background check (was 11/01). Need routing for: 1) band uplift, 2) relocation sign-on, 3) start-date change. Can we get approvals by EOD Wed? Link to packet: https://redwood.internal/offers/2319

Marcos Chen: Manager note — candidate is mission-critical for the infra team. We previously budgeted for L6 in US comp; must match UK equivalent. Manager supports band uplift + sign-on. Candidate accepts later start date. +1 from hiring manager.

Ben Keller: Heads-up on policy: cross-region uplifts >10% require committee signoff. Priya, can you open an exception form? I'll start routing to VP People and Sales Finance. Also confirm equity target & total cash so Finance can run parity check.

Hannah Li: Finance here — need total-on-target comp (base, target bonus, equity run-rate) and proposed sign-on amount. If uplift <=12% we can usually approve without Exec, but we need the numbers. Also note UK benefits/tax withholding will change net.

Priya Rao: Copying numbers now. Base proposed: GBP 120,000, sign-on ask: GBP 8,000, equity = 0.15% 4y. Total comp delta vs mapped US band = ~9.6% (pre-tax). Filling form: `EXC-2024-0987`.

CompApprovalsBot: Exception form EXC-2024-0987 submitted and routed to: VP People, Finance, and Legal. Estimated review window: 48-72h. Status: PENDING.

Marcos Chen: Candidate also requested sign-on split (50% first payroll, 50% after 6 months). Manager ok with that structure.

Ben Keller: Thanks. If committee needs to accelerate, tag me and I'll escalate. For start date, People Ops can approve internally if background finishes and tax setup is confirmed.

Hannah Li: Finance tentatively OK based on numbers provided; awaiting Legal for benefits/tax implications and final committee decision. If committee greenlights, Finance will rubber-stamp sign-on split.

Priya Rao: Great — I'll ping legal and the candidate. Will update thread when EXC-2024-0987 moves. Thanks all :thumbsup:
